description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'VehicleRequest' used for transferring vehicle-related data within the backend of the application.

classes.name: VehicleRequest
classes.description: A DTO class encapsulating vehicle information such as vehicle number, type, health status, last service date, and driver ID.

methods.name: getHealthStatus
methods.description: Returns the health status of the vehicle.

methods.name: setHealthStatus
methods.description: Sets the health status of the vehicle.
